cards.evidence: When Indianapolis Colts tight end Tyler Warren pulled up clutching his groin during a joint practice with the Atlanta Falcons, fantasy football managers everywhere held their collective breath. Soft-tissue injuries, particularly groin strains, carry a notorious reputation for lingering and recurring at the worst possible moments.
